summary: Frontend-only retest of the two LOW issues from iteration_140, using Playwright with timezone_id=America/Chicago and page.clock.install. Two clock times were used: (A) 2026-11-25 15:10 CST and (B) 2026-11-25 22:30 CST. FIX 1 PASS: in the follow-up dialog, clicking the already-selected day in followup-when-popover closes the popover. The date label is unchanged (Thu, Nov 26, 2026), Save stays enabled and the dialog stays open. Checked at both clock times. FIX 2 PASS: at 15:10, 'Later today' is shown and gives Wed Nov 25, 5:00 PM. At 22:30 the chip is absent in all three fields (followup-when, followup-next-when, book-when). In both cases the remaining chips work: Tomorrow 9am = Nov 26 9:00 AM, In 3 days = Nov 28 9:00 AM, Next week = Dec 2 9:00 AM. Defaults are unchanged at both times: new follow-up = tomorrow 9:00 AM; Log contact next and Done next = in 3 days 9:00 AM; Book inspection = tomorrow 9:00 AM. Regression PASS: picked Sat Nov 28 and 2:45 PM, saved, and GET /api/leads/{id}/follow-ups returned due_at 2026-11-28T20:45:00+00:00, which is correct. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: With `required` on Calendar, react-day-picker 8 calls onSelect with the same day on reclick, and setOpen(false) always runs. Both are correct.
quickPicks 'Later today' guard compares only getDate() of later vs now. This is fine because later is at most +2h, so a month wrap still changes the date.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To simulate time, use browser.new_context(timezone_id='America/Chicago') + page.clock.install(time=ISO) before logging in. The owner login response token key may be 'access_token'. Chip testids: <testid>-pick-later-today|tomorrow-9am|in-3-days|next-week.
